shadows.name: form-elevation
shadows.purpose: Separates the contact form from the canvas.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: One authored entrance moment on the primary hero and product media.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant next action on a section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: #30452f; color: #fffdf8; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .24s ease, transform .24s ease, box-shadow .24s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #263a25; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(47 39 31 / .12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b38a54; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: A concise product choice with audience, price and next action.
components.html:
Dành cho quán cà phê

Signature Blend

Ổn định cho vận hành quán.

Xem sản phẩm
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #cfc2ae; border-radius: 20px; background: #fffdf8; color: #2f271f; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(47 39 31 / .05); } .ds-card-label { color: #756b5f; font: 700 11px/1.2 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 12px 0 8px; font: 600 32px/1.15 'Lora', Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: #30452f; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b38a54; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled contact field with clear focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #2f271f; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #cfc2ae; border-radius: 12px; background: #fffdf8; color: #2f271f; font: 400 16px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #30452f; outline: 3px solid rgb(179 138 84 / .42); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet Vietnamese coffee palette, editorial typography and generous space help visitors choose quickly, then slow down for origin and brewing detail.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Each section has one dominant next step.

dos: Do make audience, price and size scannable.
Do use the poster as the reduced-motion video alternative.
donts: Don't hide the first CTA below a full-viewport mobile image.
Don't claim a contact request was delivered without an endpoint.
